definitions.gloss: automatic bank transfer; automatic payment; standing order
definitions.explanation: A banking service where money is automatically transferred from one account to another on a set schedule. Used for recurring payments like rent, utilities, and subscriptions.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}は{自動振込|じどうふりこみ}にしている。
examples.english: I have my rent set up as an automatic transfer.

examples.japanese: {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}の{手続|てつづ}きは{銀行|ぎんこう}の{窓口|まどぐち}でできる。
examples.english: You can set up automatic transfers at the bank counter.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}の{支払|しはら}いを{自動振込|じどうふりこみ}に{変更|へんこう}したら、{払|はら}い{忘|わす}れがなくなった。
examples.english: After switching my monthly payments to automatic transfer, I stopped forgetting to pay.

notes:
Composed of {自動|じどう} (automatic) + {振込|ふりこみ} (bank transfer). A practical banking term for recurring automatic payments. In Japan, many recurring payments like rent, utility bills, and tuition are paid via {自動振込|じどうふりこみ} or the related {自動引|じどうひ}き{落|お}とし (automatic debit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}を{設定|せってい}する: to set up automatic transfer
- {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}の{手続|てつづ}き: automatic transfer procedures
- {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}を{停止|ていし}する: to cancel automatic transfer
- {毎月|まいつき}の{自動振込|じどうふりこみ}: monthly automatic transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自動引|じどうひ}き{落|お}とし: automatic debit — money is pulled from your account by the payee; {自動振込|じどうふりこみ} is where you push money to another account
- {振込|ふりこみ}: bank transfer — a one-time manual transfer
- {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}: account transfer — often used interchangeably with {自動引|じどうひ}き{落|お}とし for utility payments
